# ModDotPlot Browser v0.9.8

**Note:** This file was generated by ChatGPT 5.6 Sol under the direction of Adam Phillippy.

v0.9.8 repairs Firefox end-to-end coverage in GitHub Actions and clarifies the
landing-page input and publication guidance.

The failed CI run loaded the static document in Firefox, but the application then
replaced it with its fatal fallback because the Linux runner did not provide a usable
WebGL2 context. Every following test waited for landing-page controls that were no
longer present. Firefox now runs against the Xvfb display installed by Playwright and
is configured to permit Mesa's software WebGL backend. Chromium and WebKit retain their
existing headless execution.

Once Firefox could complete, CI also exposed a WebKit-only screenshot readback artifact:
the exact-render test received a black image after WebKit discarded its WebGL back
buffer. The test harness now preserves that one test canvas, keeping production memory
behavior unchanged while making the cross-browser pixel oracle deterministic.

The FASTA drop area now presents supported input compression and optional index files
on separate lines, with the spelling corrected to **indices**. The former warning is
replaced with a plain-language explanation that computation stays in the browser,
followed by direct links to the ModDotPlot publication and official CLI.
